_note: Generalized mode-choice coefficients for the HELIO Flow world engine. Illustrative, calibrated to a plausible Singapore baseline split — a modelled reallocation, NOT a ridership forecast.

time_per_min.label: literature-derived
time_per_min.source: V2 calibration; within Rahman et al. IJTTE 2020 range (-0.02..-0.08)

heat.label: calibrated proxy
heat.source: UTCI heat-mobility literature; heatwaves cut active travel 20-40% (arXiv:2501.03978)

safety.label: calibrated proxy
safety.source: Plausible Singapore baseline; perceived-safety cycling literature

_asc_note: Recalibrated for the generalized utility (heat/rain/comfort/safety terms shifted the V2 baseline): targets the accepted V2 all-day split (car ~0.38, PT ~0.47, walk ~0.08, cycle ~0.06), HTS-informed. Label: calibrated proxy.
_wait_note: bus wait overridden at runtime by measured LTA headways (data/lta_frequencies.json peak_wait_min). Label: measured.

baseline_pt_share.label: measured
baseline_pt_share.source: LTA Household Travel Survey peak-period PT mode share (~65%)

_exposure_note: Fraction of a trip's heat/rain exposure felt per mode (bus/mrt = first/last-mile walking). Label: calibrated proxy.
_weight_note: How strongly comfort/safety scores act on each mode's utility (cycling most safety-sensitive per ITDP protected-lane literature). Label: calibrated proxy.
